title: Account for stale retained exchange constructions through an explicit custody audit
outcome: A provably never-canonical retained exchange construction can be explicitly retired without deleting its evidence, allowing a fresh current request while preserving canonical progress and unknown-custody refusal.
acceptance: An explicit supported audit operation accounts for selected retained delta, evidence or successor construction only when its exact retained identity and bytes, actor/project/origin/store scope and absence of canonical progress are proven under existing reservation and writer rules; canonical or uncertain operations refuse, and the retired operation cannot later apply.

Real-owner behavior covers incoming retention followed by a native edit without a live claim and retained successor followed by native movement: stale apply refuses without canonical mutation, explicit audit preserves and accounts original artifacts, then a fresh request succeeds. Mismatched selection, changed bytes, committed or foreign/uncertain operations refuse atomically.

The author delivers a complete exact-source focused-check package with shared-file dependency accounting and durable-schema/import/projection/cutover impact assessment; no private artifact deletion, history rewrite, Git authority expansion, or change to live-claim deferral is introduced.

completion.summary: Delivered explicit custody retirement of provably never-canonical retained delta, evidence and successor constructions while preserving original bytes, holds and execution history. Exact-scope and canonical/uncertain refusal remain enforced; fresh supported requests can proceed. Fresh independent evaluation 87342c3b080b48099cc6b61852865c44 passed 3/3. Implementation is handed to the integration parent; no landing or installation claimed.
